cbse-class-10.title: CBSE Class 10 Important Chapters 2027: Marks, Answer Tips & Past Papers
cbse-class-10.h1: CBSE Class 10 Board Exam 2027: Important Chapters and How to Prepare
cbse-class-10.description: Unit-wise marks for CBSE Class 10 Science, Maths and Social Science 2027, which chapters to study first, how to write answers, a 30-day plan and official past papers.
intro: The fastest way to prepare for the CBSE Class 10 board exam is to know where the marks are. CBSE publishes the marks for every unit in its 2026-27 curriculum, and a few units carry a large share of each paper. In Science, two units — chemical substances and the world of living — are worth 50 of the 80 theory marks. In Mathematics, Algebra alone is 20 marks, a quarter of the paper.

This page puts those numbers in one place for Science, Mathematics and Social Science, marks every unit as high, medium or low priority, and says for each one how to write the answer and how to revise it quickly. It also links to CBSE's own question papers from the 2026 and 2025 board exams, and you can download the whole plan as a spreadsheet.

units.chapters: Chemical Reactions & Equations; Acids, Bases & Salts; Metals & Non-metals; Carbon & its Compounds
units.answer: Write balanced equations with state symbols and name the type of reaction. For carbon compounds, draw the structure and give the IUPAC name.
units.prep: Make one page of every reaction in the four chapters and read it daily. Practise pH, uses of salts and the reactivity series from past papers.

units.chapters: Life Processes; Control & Coordination; How do Organisms Reproduce?; Heredity
units.answer: Draw and label the diagrams — heart, nephron, neuron, flower, alimentary canal. Use NCERT keywords and answer in points.
units.prep: Practise the eight to ten standard diagrams until each takes two minutes. For Heredity, practise Mendel's monohybrid and dihybrid crosses.

units.chapters: Electricity; Magnetic Effects of Electric Current
units.answer: For numericals write the formula, then the values with units, then the answer with its unit. Draw circuits with the correct symbols.
units.prep: Learn Ohm's law, resistances in series and parallel, and the power and heating formulas, then solve 15–20 numericals from past papers.

units.chapters: Light – Reflection & Refraction; The Human Eye & the Colourful World
units.answer: Draw ray diagrams with a ruler and arrows. Use the sign convention in mirror and lens numericals and show every step.
units.prep: Practise the six mirror and six lens ray-diagram cases and the mirror and lens formulas. Revise defects of vision and how they are corrected.

units.chapters: Our Environment
units.answer: Short answers with an example: a food chain, the 10% law, the ozone layer.
units.prep: A short chapter: read the NCERT text once and revise the in-text questions for quick marks.

units.chapters: Polynomials; Pair of Linear Equations in Two Variables; Quadratic Equations; Arithmetic Progressions
units.answer: Write the formula first, then every step, and box the final answer. CBSE gives marks for steps even when the final answer is wrong.
units.prep: The biggest unit. Do the NCERT examples and exercises, then word problems on quadratic equations and APs from the last two years' papers.

units.chapters: Triangles; Circles
units.answer: Write Given, To Prove, Construction and Proof, with a reason for every step, and draw a neat figure.
units.prep: Learn the proofs of the Basic Proportionality Theorem and the tangent theorems — they are asked often. Then practise similarity problems.

units.chapters: Introduction to Trigonometry; Some Applications of Trigonometry
units.answer: For heights and distances always draw the figure and mark the angles. For identities, work on one side only.
units.prep: Memorise the ratio table and the three identities, then practise ten identity proofs and ten heights-and-distances problems.

units.chapters: Statistics; Probability
units.answer: Build the full table (class mark, frequency, cumulative frequency) before using the formula. For probability, write the total outcomes first.
units.prep: Very scoring: practise mean, median and mode of grouped data, and dice, card and coin probability.

units.chapters: Areas Related to Circles; Surface Areas & Volumes
units.answer: Write the formula, substitute, and keep the units (cm², cm³). Draw the combined solid.
units.prep: Make a formula sheet and practise questions on combinations of solids.

units.chapters: Real Numbers
units.answer: Show the prime factorisation clearly. Write irrationality proofs by contradiction.
units.prep: Quick marks: HCF and LCM, and the proofs that √2 and √3 are irrational.

units.chapters: Coordinate Geometry
units.answer: Write the distance or section formula, then substitute.
units.prep: Only two formulas to learn — distance and section — so these are easy marks.

units.chapters: India and the Contemporary World – II (5 chapters) and map work
units.answer: Answer in points with dates and names. For 5-mark answers write an opening line, four or five points and a closing line. Practise the history map items.
units.prep: Start with Nationalism in India and The Rise of Nationalism in Europe, the longest chapters, and make a timeline of events.

units.chapters: Contemporary India – II (7 chapters) and map work
units.answer: Give examples — crops, states, industries. On the map, mark accurately and label clearly.
units.prep: Practise the official map list for five minutes every day, and learn crops, minerals and industries as tables.

units.chapters: Democratic Politics – II (5 chapters)
units.answer: Define the term, then explain it with examples, such as Belgium and Sri Lanka for power sharing.
units.prep: A short book for 20 marks. Read each chapter twice and make one page of notes per chapter.

units.chapters: Understanding Economic Development (5 chapters)
units.answer: Define terms exactly — GDP, sectors, credit — and use the tables and data from the NCERT book.
units.prep: Practise the case-based questions in the sample paper; they are built on data tables.

units.chapters: First Flight; Footprints without Feet; grammar; letter and analytical paragraph
units.answer: Keep to the word limit and follow the format exactly (a letter needs address, date, subject and salutation). In literature answers, refer to characters and events by name.
units.prep: Read a summary of every chapter, practise two formal letters and two analytical paragraphs, and solve the unseen passages in past papers.

units.chapters: Kshitij and Kritika (A); Sparsh and Sanchayan (B); grammar; letter and notice
units.answer: Answer in clear points, follow the letter and notice formats, and give one example for each grammar rule.
units.prep: Learn each poet's and author's name with the main idea of the piece. Grammar is the quickest source of marks, so practise it from past papers.

faqs.question: Which chapters are most important for CBSE Class 10 Science 2027?
faqs.answer: By marks, the chemistry chapters (Chemical Reactions, Acids Bases and Salts, Metals and Non-metals, Carbon and its Compounds) and the biology chapters (Life Processes, Control and Coordination, Reproduction, Heredity). Each group is a 25-mark unit, so together they are 50 of the 80 theory marks.

faqs.question: Which unit carries the most marks in Class 10 Maths?
faqs.answer: Algebra, with 20 of the 80 theory marks. It covers Polynomials, Pair of Linear Equations, Quadratic Equations and Arithmetic Progressions. Geometry is next with 15.

faqs.question: How are marks split in Class 10 Social Science?
faqs.answer: Equally: History, Geography, Political Science and Economics carry 20 marks each. Map work is 5 marks in all, 2 within History and 3 within Geography.

faqs.question: Is it safe to skip low-priority chapters?
faqs.answer: No. Low priority means fewer marks, not zero. Study high-priority units first, but revise every chapter at least once — short chapters such as Our Environment or Coordinate Geometry are often the easiest marks in the paper.

faqs.question: Where can I download official CBSE Class 10 previous year papers?
faqs.answer: On cbse.gov.in under Previous Years' Question Papers. The table on this page links directly to CBSE's files for 2026 and 2025.

cbse-class-12.title: CBSE Class 12 Important Chapters 2027: Marks, Answer Tips & Past Papers
cbse-class-12.h1: CBSE Class 12 Board Exam 2027: Important Chapters and How to Prepare
cbse-class-12.description: Unit-wise marks for CBSE Class 12 Physics, Chemistry, Maths, Biology, Accountancy and Economics 2027, what to study first, answer-writing tips and official past papers.
intro: In the CBSE Class 12 board exam a handful of units decide most of the result. CBSE's 2026-27 curriculum gives Calculus 35 of the 80 theory marks in Mathematics, Partnership Firms 36 of 80 in Accountancy, and Genetics and Evolution 20 of 70 in Biology. Knowing these numbers tells you where an hour of study is worth the most.

This page lists the official unit marks for Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, Biology, Accountancy and Economics, marks each unit as high, medium or low priority, and gives a short guide to answering and revising each one. Below that are CBSE's own 2026 and 2025 question papers for 18 subjects, a 30-day revision plan and exam-day rules. The whole plan is also available as a spreadsheet to download.

units.chapters: EM Waves; Ray Optics & Optical Instruments; Wave Optics
units.answer: Draw ray diagrams with arrows and labels. For derivations: diagram, steps, then the final formula boxed.
units.prep: The lens-maker's formula, refraction through a prism, Young's double slit and the microscope and telescope come up again and again.

units.chapters: Moving Charges & Magnetism; Magnetism & Matter; Electromagnetic Induction; Alternating Current
units.answer: State the law, draw the figure, then derive. In numericals use SI units and give the answer with its unit.
units.prep: Learn the derivations: uses of Biot–Savart and Ampère's laws, force between parallel wires, self and mutual inductance, the LCR circuit and the transformer.

units.chapters: Electric Charges & Fields; Electrostatic Potential & Capacitance; Current Electricity
units.answer: For Gauss's law, draw the Gaussian surface. For Kirchhoff's laws, mark the current directions first.
units.prep: Practise capacitor combinations, the Wheatstone and metre bridges, and the potential due to a dipole.

units.chapters: Dual Nature of Radiation & Matter; Atoms; Nuclei
units.answer: Short, formula-based answers. Draw the photoelectric graphs with labelled axes.
units.prep: Very scoring: Einstein's photoelectric equation, de Broglie wavelength, the Bohr model and the binding-energy curve.

units.chapters: Semiconductor Electronics
units.answer: Draw the circuit diagrams and the I–V graphs for the p-n junction and rectifiers.
units.prep: One chapter: learn half-wave and full-wave rectifiers and the diode characteristics.

units.chapters: Electrochemistry
units.answer: Write the cell notation and the Nernst equation with values, and give units for conductivity.
units.prep: Practise Nernst equation, molar conductivity and Kohlrausch's law numericals from past papers.

units.chapters: Aldehydes, Ketones and Carboxylic Acids
units.answer: Write reactions with the conditions over the arrow. For a named reaction, give the equation, not just the name.
units.prep: Make a sheet of named reactions — aldol, Cannizzaro, Clemmensen, HVZ — and read it daily.

units.chapters: Solutions
units.answer: In colligative-property numericals, write the formula and the units at each step.
units.prep: Raoult's law, the van't Hoff factor and colligative numericals.

units.chapters: Chemical Kinetics
units.answer: Show the integrated rate law and each step of the log calculation.
units.prep: First-order and half-life numericals and the Arrhenius equation.

units.chapters: The d- and f-Block Elements
units.answer: Give each 'reason' in one line, such as why transition metals are coloured.
units.prep: Learn the trend-based 'give reasons' questions and the lanthanoid contraction.

units.chapters: Coordination Compounds
units.answer: Put the IUPAC name, hybridisation and magnetic nature in a small table.
units.prep: Practise naming and crystal-field splitting for ten complexes.

units.chapters: Biomolecules
units.answer: Short definitions and structures, such as glucose and the peptide bond.
units.prep: A theory-only chapter, so quick revision gives sure marks.

units.chapters: Haloalkanes and Haloarenes
units.answer: Explain SN1 and SN2 with the mechanism and conditions.
units.prep: Learn the conversions and the mechanisms.

units.chapters: Alcohols, Phenols and Ethers
units.answer: Write reactions with the reagents, and the tests that tell compounds apart.
units.prep: Practise conversions and distinguishing tests.

units.chapters: Amines
units.answer: Give the order of basicity with the reason; the Hofmann and Gabriel reactions.
units.prep: Learn the distinguishing tests and the reactions of diazonium salts.

units.chapters: Continuity & Differentiability; Application of Derivatives; Integrals; Application of Integrals; Differential Equations
units.answer: Show every step, because step marks matter. Draw the region in area questions and write + C.
units.prep: Nearly half the paper: do every NCERT integration exercise, then maxima and minima word problems.

units.chapters: Vectors; Three-Dimensional Geometry
units.answer: Write vectors with arrows or hats. In 3D, state the formula, such as for shortest distance, before using it.
units.prep: Shortest distance between lines and the angle between lines are frequent five-mark questions.

units.chapters: Matrices; Determinants
units.answer: Check an inverse by multiplying back to the identity, and show the cofactors in a grid.
units.prep: Solving equations by the matrix method is almost always asked.

units.chapters: Relations and Functions; Inverse Trigonometric Functions
units.answer: For an equivalence relation, prove reflexive, symmetric and transitive one by one.
units.prep: Learn the table of principal-value branches.

units.chapters: Probability
units.answer: Describe the events in words first. For Bayes' theorem, draw a tree.
units.prep: Bayes' theorem and probability distributions come up often.

units.chapters: Linear Programming
units.answer: Draw the graph neatly, shade the feasible region and make a table of corner points.
units.prep: Full marks with one well-practised method.

units.chapters: Principles of Inheritance & Variation; Molecular Basis of Inheritance; Evolution
units.answer: Draw crosses with Punnett squares. Explain the lac operon and DNA replication with diagrams.
units.prep: The largest unit: start with Molecular Basis of Inheritance.

units.chapters: Sexual Reproduction in Flowering Plants; Human Reproduction; Reproductive Health
units.answer: Labelled diagrams — embryo sac, sections of testis and ovary, the menstrual cycle.
units.prep: Practise the diagrams daily and learn each process as a flowchart.

units.chapters: Human Health & Disease; Microbes in Human Welfare
units.answer: Give disease, pathogen, symptoms and prevention as a table.
units.prep: Revising in tables is fastest.

units.chapters: Biotechnology: Principles & Processes; Biotechnology & its Applications
units.answer: Explain steps in order, such as recombinant DNA and PCR, as a flowchart.
units.prep: Learn the steps of recombinant DNA technology and PCR, and Bt crops.

units.chapters: Organisms & Populations; Ecosystem; Biodiversity & Conservation
units.answer: Use graphs, such as population growth curves, and examples.
units.prep: Short chapters and quick marks.

units.chapters: Fundamentals; change in profit-sharing ratio; admission; retirement and death; dissolution
units.answer: Show working notes. Every journal entry needs a narration. Prepare ledgers and the balance sheet neatly.
units.prep: Almost half the paper: practise admission and retirement questions from past papers.

units.chapters: Issue of Shares; Issue of Debentures
units.answer: Use the correct account names and show calculations in working notes.
units.prep: Practise forfeiture and re-issue of shares, and issue of debentures.

units.chapters: Financial statements; comparative and common-size statements; accounting ratios
units.answer: Write the ratio formula, then the values, then the answer.
units.prep: Keep all ratio formulas on one sheet.

units.chapters: Cash Flow Statement
units.answer: Follow the format: operating, investing and financing activities.
units.prep: Practise three complete cash-flow statements.

units.chapters: All Part B chapters
units.answer: Use data and current examples, and answer in points with headings.
units.prep: Half the paper: make one page of notes per chapter.

units.chapters: Aggregate demand, the multiplier, deficient and excess demand
units.answer: Draw diagrams with labelled axes and show the multiplier steps.
units.prep: Numericals on the multiplier and aggregate demand.

units.chapters: National income, methods of calculation, GDP and welfare
units.answer: Write the formula, then the values, showing each step.
units.prep: Practise national-income numericals by all three methods.

units.chapters: Money, credit creation, functions of the RBI
units.answer: Define the terms and explain the RBI's tools.
units.prep: Quick theory revision.

units.chapters: Components of the budget; deficits
units.answer: Give the formulas for fiscal, revenue and primary deficit.
units.prep: Short and scoring.

units.chapters: Balance of payments; foreign exchange rate
units.answer: Use the balance-of-payments table format.
units.prep: Short and scoring.

units.chapters: Flamingo; Vistas; notice, invitation, letter, article
units.answer: Follow formats and word limits exactly, and refer to events and characters by name in literature answers.
units.prep: Read a summary of each chapter, practise one of each writing format, and solve three unseen passages from past papers.

faqs.question: Which chapters are most important in CBSE Class 12 Maths 2027?
faqs.answer: Calculus — Continuity and Differentiability, Application of Derivatives, Integrals, Application of Integrals and Differential Equations — carries 35 of the 80 theory marks. Vectors and 3D Geometry is next with 14.

faqs.question: How are marks distributed in Class 12 Physics?
faqs.answer: The 70 theory marks are split across nine units, grouped as: Electrostatics and Current Electricity 16, Magnetism and EMI/AC 17, EM Waves and Optics 18, Dual Nature, Atoms and Nuclei 12, and Electronic Devices 7. Practicals carry the other 30.

faqs.question: Which Chemistry chapter has the highest weightage in Class 12?
faqs.answer: Electrochemistry, with 9 of 70 marks, followed by Aldehydes, Ketones and Carboxylic Acids with 8. The other chapters carry 6 or 7 each, so Chemistry rewards covering the whole book.

faqs.question: What is the most important part of Class 12 Accountancy?
faqs.answer: Accounting for Partnership Firms, worth 36 of the 80 theory marks, followed by Accounting for Companies with 24.

faqs.question: Where can I get official CBSE Class 12 previous year papers?
faqs.answer: On cbse.gov.in under Previous Years' Question Papers. The table on this page links directly to CBSE's files for 2026 and 2025 in 18 subjects.

This page lists UPMSP's own unit marks for Science, Mathematics and Social Science, ranks every unit, and explains how to answer and revise each one quickly. units.chapters: India and the Contemporary World – 2
units.answer: Answer in points with dates and names, and practise the history map items — UPMSP sets part of these marks on the map.
units.prep: Start with the nationalism chapters, the longest in the book, and make a timeline of events.

units.chapters: Contemporary India – 2
units.answer: Give examples — crops, states, industries. On the outline map of India, mark accurately and label clearly.

units.prep: Read a summary of every lesson and poem, practise two letters and two applications, and do grammar from the model paper.

units.chapters: Prose, poetry, grammar, letter and essay writing
units.answer: Write answers in clear points, give the author or poet's name and the main idea, and follow the letter and essay formats.

You need 33% in each subject to pass, so do not leave any subject weak.

faqs.question: Which chapters are most important in UP Board Class 10 Science?

Each group is a 20-mark unit, so together they are 40 of the 70 written marks.

faqs.question: Which unit carries the most marks in UP Board Class 10 Maths?

faqs.question: How are marks split in UP Board Class 10 Social Science?
faqs.answer: History and Geography carry 20 marks each, including map work, and Civics and Economics 15 marks each, for 70 in all.

faqs.question: Is the UP Board syllabus the same as CBSE?
faqs.answer: The textbooks are the same NCERT books, but the unit marks are UPMSP's own and the paper is 70 written marks, not 80. Use UPMSP's marks to plan.

faqs.question: Where can I get UP Board model papers?
faqs.answer: On upmsp.edu.in, under Model Paper. UPMSP publishes them subject-wise for Class 10 and Class 12.

up-board-class-12.h1: UP Board Class 12 (Intermediate) 2027: Important Chapters and How to Prepare
up-board-class-12.description: Unit-wise marks for UP Board Class 12 Physics, Chemistry, Maths and Biology 2027, what to study first, answer-writing tips and where to get UPMSP model papers.
intro: In the UP Board Intermediate exam the science papers are 70 written marks with 30 for practicals, while Mathematics is a 100-mark written paper. UPMSP's 2026-27 syllabus gives Calculus 44 of those 100 Maths marks, Optics 13 of 70 in Physics, and Genetics and Evolution 18 of 70 in Biology.

This page lists UPMSP's own unit marks for Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics and Biology, ranks every unit by its share of the paper, and gives a short guide to answering and revising each one. The books are NCERT's, so the chapter names match CBSE's, but the marks do not. The full plan is also available as a spreadsheet.

units.chapters: Ray Optics & Optical Instruments; Wave Optics
units.answer: Draw ray diagrams with arrows and labels. For derivations: diagram, steps, then the final formula boxed.
units.prep: The biggest single unit: lens-maker's formula, prism, microscope and telescope, Young's double slit.

units.chapters: Electric Charges & Fields; Electrostatic Potential & Capacitance
units.answer: For Gauss's law, draw the Gaussian surface; show each step of capacitor combinations.
units.prep: Gauss's law applications, potential due to a dipole, capacitors.

units.chapters: Moving Charges & Magnetism; Magnetism & Matter
units.answer: State the law, draw the figure, then derive.
units.prep: Biot–Savart and Ampère's law, force on a conductor, moving-coil galvanometer.

units.chapters: Electromagnetic Induction; Alternating Current
units.answer: Derive with a labelled figure; in numericals give the answer with its unit.
units.prep: Self and mutual inductance, the LCR circuit, resonance and the transformer.

units.chapters: Atoms; Nuclei
units.answer: Short, formula-based answers with the Bohr model figure where asked.
units.prep: Bohr model, hydrogen spectrum, binding energy, radioactive decay.

units.chapters: Semiconductor Electronics
units.answer: Draw the circuit diagram and the I–V graph for diodes and rectifiers.
units.prep: Full marks are realistic: p-n junction, rectifiers, logic of the diode.

units.chapters: Current Electricity
units.answer: For Kirchhoff's laws mark current directions first; label the bridge diagrams.
units.prep: Wheatstone and metre bridges, potentiometer, cells in series and parallel.

units.chapters: Dual Nature of Radiation and Matter
units.answer: Draw the photoelectric graphs with labelled axes.
units.prep: Einstein's photoelectric equation and de Broglie wavelength numericals.

units.chapters: Electromagnetic Waves
units.answer: Give the order of the spectrum with one use of each band.
units.prep: Learn the spectrum table; quick marks.

units.chapters: Solutions
units.answer: In colligative-property numericals, write the formula and the units at each step.
units.prep: Raoult's law, the van't Hoff factor and colligative numericals.

units.chapters: Aldehydes, Ketones and Carboxylic Acids
units.answer: Write reactions with the conditions over the arrow. For a named reaction, give the equation, not just the name.
units.prep: Make a sheet of named reactions — aldol, Cannizzaro, Clemmensen, HVZ — and read it daily.

units.chapters: Electrochemistry
units.answer: Write the cell notation and the Nernst equation with values, and give units for conductivity.
units.prep: Practise Nernst equation, molar conductivity and Kohlrausch's law numericals from past papers.

units.chapters: Chemical Kinetics
units.answer: Show the integrated rate law and each step of the log calculation.
units.prep: First-order and half-life numericals and the Arrhenius equation.

units.chapters: Coordination Compounds
units.answer: Put the IUPAC name, hybridisation and magnetic nature in a small table.
units.prep: Practise naming and crystal-field splitting for ten complexes.

units.chapters: Haloalkanes and Haloarenes
units.answer: Explain SN1 and SN2 with the mechanism and conditions.
units.prep: Learn the conversions and the mechanisms.

units.chapters: Alcohols, Phenols and Ethers
units.answer: Write reactions with the reagents, and the tests that tell compounds apart.
units.prep: Practise conversions and distinguishing tests.

units.chapters: Biomolecules
units.answer: Short definitions and structures, such as glucose and the peptide bond.
units.prep: A theory-only chapter, so quick revision gives sure marks.

units.chapters: The d- and f-Block Elements
units.answer: Give each 'reason' in one line, such as why transition metals are coloured.
units.prep: Learn the trend-based 'give reasons' questions and the lanthanoid contraction.

units.chapters: Amines
units.answer: Give the order of basicity with the reason; the Hofmann and Gabriel reactions.
units.prep: Learn the distinguishing tests and the reactions of diazonium salts.

units.chapters: Continuity & Differentiability; Application of Derivatives; Integrals; Application of Integrals; Differential Equations
units.answer: Show every step, because step marks matter. Draw the region in area questions and write + C.
units.prep: Nearly half the paper: do every NCERT integration exercise, then maxima and minima word problems.

units.chapters: Vectors; Three-Dimensional Geometry
units.answer: Write vectors with arrows or hats. In 3D, state the formula, such as for shortest distance, before using it.
units.prep: Shortest distance between lines and the angle between lines are frequent five-mark questions.

units.chapters: Matrices; Determinants
units.answer: Check an inverse by multiplying back to the identity, and show the cofactors in a grid.
units.prep: Solving equations by the matrix method is almost always asked.

units.chapters: Relations and Functions; Inverse Trigonometric Functions
units.answer: For an equivalence relation, prove reflexive, symmetric and transitive one by one.
units.prep: Learn the table of principal-value branches.

units.chapters: Probability
units.answer: Describe the events in words first. For Bayes' theorem, draw a tree.
units.prep: Bayes' theorem and probability distributions come up often.

units.chapters: Linear Programming
units.answer: Draw the graph neatly, shade the feasible region and make a table of corner points.
units.prep: Full marks with one well-practised method.

units.chapters: Principles of Inheritance & Variation; Molecular Basis of Inheritance; Evolution
units.answer: Draw crosses with Punnett squares. Explain the lac operon and DNA replication with diagrams.
units.prep: The largest unit: start with Molecular Basis of Inheritance.

units.chapters: Sexual Reproduction in Flowering Plants; Human Reproduction; Reproductive Health
units.answer: Labelled diagrams — embryo sac, sections of testis and ovary, the menstrual cycle.
units.prep: Practise the diagrams daily and learn each process as a flowchart.

units.chapters: Human Health & Disease; Microbes in Human Welfare
units.answer: Give disease, pathogen, symptoms and prevention as a table.
units.prep: Revising in tables is fastest.

units.chapters: Organisms & Populations; Ecosystem; Biodiversity & Conservation
units.answer: Use graphs, such as population growth curves, and examples.
units.prep: Short chapters and quick marks.

units.chapters: Biotechnology: Principles & Processes; Biotechnology & its Applications
units.answer: Explain steps in order, such as recombinant DNA and PCR, as a flowchart.
units.prep: Learn the steps of recombinant DNA technology and PCR, and Bt crops.

units.chapters: Flamingo; Vistas; grammar; letter, application and essay
units.answer: Follow formats and word limits exactly, and refer to events and characters by name.
units.prep: Read lesson summaries, practise one letter, one application and one essay, and do the grammar section of the model paper.

up-board-class-12.papersNote: UPMSP publishes model papers for every subject on upmsp.edu.in; they show the current pattern, including the multiple-choice part. We could not find previous years' question papers on UPMSP's own website, so practise with the model papers first.
notes: Physics, Chemistry and Biology have a 70-mark written paper and 30 marks of practicals; Mathematics is a 100-mark written paper.
You need 33% in each subject to pass, in the written paper and the practical.
Recent UP Board papers begin with multiple-choice questions answered on an OMR sheet: fill each bubble carefully.

faqs.question: Which unit carries the most marks in UP Board Class 12 Maths?
faqs.answer: Calculus, with 44 of the 100 marks — nearly half the paper. Vectors and 3D Geometry is next with 18.

faqs.question: Which Physics unit is most important for UP Board Class 12?
faqs.answer: Optics, with 13 of the 70 written marks. Electrostatics, Magnetism, EMI and AC, Atoms and Nuclei and Electronic Devices carry 8 each.

faqs.question: How are UP Board Class 12 Biology marks split?
faqs.answer: Genetics and Evolution 18, Reproduction 14, Biology and Human Welfare 14, Ecology 14 and Biotechnology 10, for 70 written marks.

faqs.question: Is UP Board Chemistry the same as CBSE?
faqs.answer: The ten chapters are the same NCERT chapters, but UPMSP spreads the marks more evenly: every chapter carries 6 to 8 marks, so leave none out.

faqs.question: Where can I get UP Board Class 12 model papers?
faqs.answer: On upmsp.edu.in, under Model Paper, subject-wise.

icse-class-10.title: ICSE Class 10 Important Chapters 2027: Paper Pattern & Prep Tips
icse-class-10.h1: ICSE Class 10 Board Exam 2027: Important Chapters and How to Prepare
icse-class-10.description: ICSE Class 10 2027 Maths, Physics, Chemistry and Biology chapters, how the paper is set, how to write answers, a 30-day plan and where to get CISCE specimen papers.
intro: ICSE is different from CBSE and the state boards in one important way: CISCE does not publish marks for each chapter. Instead, every main paper has a compulsory first section that covers the whole syllabus and a second section where you choose questions. So in ICSE no chapter is safe to skip — and the way to score is to know every chapter well enough to answer short compulsory questions, and a few chapters very well for the long ones.

For 2027 CISCE has also said that about half of the marks will come from higher-order, competency-based questions. This page lists the chapters of Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry and Biology, with how to answer and revise each, explains the paper pattern, and links to CISCE's official specimen papers. You can download the whole plan as a spreadsheet.

units.chapters: GST; Banking (recurring deposit); Shares and Dividends
units.answer: Write the formula, then substitute with ₹ and % units, and state the final answer in a sentence.
units.prep: Short and scoring: practise ten questions of each type from the specimen and past papers.

units.chapters: Linear inequations; Quadratic equations; Ratio and proportion; Factorisation; Matrices; Progressions
units.answer: Show every step; for word problems, define the variable first and check the answer fits the question.
units.prep: The largest part of the syllabus: do quadratic word problems and matrices daily.

units.chapters: Similarity; Loci; Circles; Constructions; Coordinate geometry (reflection, section formula, equation of a line)
units.answer: Give a reason for every statement in proofs; draw constructions with a sharp pencil and keep the arcs.
units.prep: Circle theorems and constructions come up in Section B almost every year.

units.chapters: Cylinder, cone and sphere; combinations of solids
units.answer: Write the formula, keep the units, and say clearly what is being found.
units.prep: Make one formula sheet and practise conversion (melting and recasting) problems.

units.chapters: Identities; Heights and distances
units.answer: Draw the figure and mark angles; for identities, work on one side only.
units.prep: Practise ten identities and ten heights-and-distances problems with the tables.

units.chapters: Mean, median, quartiles and mode; histograms and ogives
units.answer: Draw graphs to scale on graph paper and label both axes.
units.prep: Graph questions are quick marks if the scale is right.

units.chapters: Probability
units.answer: List the sample space first.
units.prep: Easy marks: dice, coins and cards.

units.chapters: Force; Work, Energy and Power; Machines
units.answer: Numericals: formula, values with SI units, answer with unit. Draw lever and pulley diagrams.
units.prep: Machines (MA, VR, efficiency) and moment of force numericals are asked every year.

units.chapters: Refraction at plane surfaces; Refraction through a lens; Spectrum
units.answer: Ray diagrams with a ruler and arrows; give the sign convention you use.
units.prep: Practise lens ray diagrams, critical angle and total internal reflection.

units.chapters: Sound
units.answer: Define terms exactly (natural, forced vibrations, resonance) and give one example each.
units.prep: Echo numericals and the characteristics of sound.

units.chapters: Current electricity; Household circuits; Electromagnetism
units.answer: Draw circuit diagrams with standard symbols; show the series/parallel calculation.
units.prep: Resistor combinations, power and energy bills, and the AC generator and motor.

units.chapters: Calorimetry
units.answer: State the principle of calorimetry and write heat lost = heat gained before substituting.
units.prep: Specific and latent heat numericals.

units.chapters: Radioactivity
units.answer: Write nuclear equations with mass and atomic numbers balanced.
units.prep: Alpha, beta and gamma changes and their properties.

units.chapters: Periodic properties and their variations; Chemical bonding
units.answer: Explain trends with a reason (atomic size, ionisation potential). Draw electron-dot structures.
units.prep: Learn the trends down a group and across a period as a table.

units.unit: Acids, Bases and Salts; Analytical Chemistry
units.chapters: Acids, bases and salts; Analytical chemistry (reactions with ammonium and sodium hydroxide)
units.answer: Write balanced equations and give the observation (colour of precipitate).
units.prep: Make a table of precipitate colours; it answers many short questions.

units.chapters: Mole concept; Gay-Lussac's law; empirical and molecular formula
units.answer: Show the calculation steps and units; state the law used.
units.prep: Practise ten numericals; they are high-scoring with method.

units.chapters: Electrolysis; Metallurgy (aluminium); alloys
units.answer: Write electrode reactions for each electrode and name the products.
units.prep: Electrolysis of copper sulphate and the extraction of aluminium are asked often.

units.chapters: Hydrogen chloride; Ammonia; Nitric acid; Sulphuric acid
units.answer: Laboratory preparation: reactants, equation, conditions and a labelled diagram.
units.prep: Learn the four lab preparations and their key reactions.

units.chapters: Organic chemistry
units.answer: IUPAC names, structures and reactions with conditions.
units.prep: Homologous series, isomers and the reactions of alkanes, alkenes, alkynes, alcohols and acids.

units.chapters: Cell cycle and cell division; Genetics
units.answer: Draw and label the stages of mitosis; use Punnett squares for crosses.
units.prep: Genetics crosses and mitosis versus meiosis tables.

units.chapters: Absorption by roots; Transpiration; Photosynthesis; Chemical coordination in plants
units.answer: Give experiments with aim, set-up, observation and conclusion.
units.prep: Learn the standard experiments and their diagrams.

units.chapters: Circulatory, excretory, nervous, endocrine and reproductive systems
units.answer: Labelled diagrams (heart, nephron, eye, ear, brain); use correct terms.
units.prep: Diagram practice daily: these chapters carry most long answers.

units.chapters: Population; Pollution
units.answer: Answer with causes, effects and measures in points.
units.prep: Short chapters; revise with a one-page summary.

units.chapters: Composition, letter, notice and comprehension; prescribed texts
units.answer: Plan compositions before writing; follow the letter format exactly; quote from the text in literature answers.
units.prep: Write one composition and one letter every week and get them checked.

units.chapters: Union Parliament, Executive and Judiciary; Indian National Movement; contemporary world
units.answer: Answer in points with dates and names; state constitutional provisions precisely.
units.prep: Make timelines for the national movement and tables for Parliament's powers.

units.chapters: Topographical map interpretation; map of India; physical and economic geography of India
units.answer: Read the toposheet carefully and use grid references; on the India map, mark and label clearly.
units.prep: Practise one toposheet and one India map a week.

icse-class-10.papersNote: CISCE publishes specimen question papers, with answer keys for selected subjects, on cisce.org (Examinations → ICSE → Specimen Question Papers). They are the best guide to the 2027 pattern.

source.name: CISCE ICSE regulations and syllabuses 2027 and specimen papers (cisce.org)

notes: CISCE does not publish marks for individual chapters in ICSE. The priority column therefore reads 'Whole paper': every chapter can appear in the compulsory section.

Mathematics is one 80-mark paper with 20 marks of internal assessment. Section A (40 marks) is compulsory and covers the whole syllabus; in Section B (40 marks) you answer any four questions out of seven.
Science is three separate papers — Physics, Chemistry and Biology — each with a compulsory Section A and a Section B where you choose questions.
For 2027 CISCE says about half of the marks will test higher-order thinking and application, so practise the specimen paper's case-based and reasoning questions, not just definitions.

faqs.question: Which chapters are most important for ICSE Class 10 2027?
faqs.answer: CISCE does not give marks per chapter, and Section A of each paper is compulsory and covers the whole syllabus, so every chapter matters. For the long Section B questions, Algebra and Geometry in Maths, Machines, Light and Electricity in Physics, and Study of Compounds and Mole Concept in Chemistry are asked very often.

faqs.question: What is the ICSE Class 10 Maths paper pattern?
faqs.answer: One 80-mark paper plus 20 marks of internal assessment. Section A (40 marks) is compulsory; in Section B (40 marks) you answer any four of seven questions.

faqs.question: Is it safe to skip chapters in ICSE?
faqs.answer: No. Section A is compulsory and is set from the whole syllabus, so a skipped chapter costs marks you cannot choose your way out of.

faqs.question: What changed in ICSE 2027 papers?
faqs.answer: CISCE has said about 50% of the marks in 2027 will go to higher-order, competency-based questions. The 2027 specimen papers show what these look like.

faqs.question: Where can I get ICSE specimen papers?
faqs.answer: On cisce.org, under the ICSE examination section, as Specimen Question Papers for 2027.

isc-class-12.h1: ISC Class 12 Board Exam 2027: Important Chapters and How to Prepare
isc-class-12.description: Unit-wise marks for ISC Class 12 Physics, Chemistry, Maths and Biology 2027, what to study first, answer-writing tips and where to get CISCE specimen papers.
intro: Unlike ICSE, the ISC syllabus does give marks for each unit, and they show clear priorities. In Physics, Optics alone is 18 of the 70 theory marks; in Chemistry, organic chemistry is 31 of 70; and in Mathematics, Calculus is 35 of 80.

This page lists CISCE's unit marks for ISC Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics and Biology, ranks every unit by its share of the paper, and gives a short guide to answering and revising each one. CISCE says about half of the 2027 marks will test higher-order thinking, so the specimen papers linked below are essential practice. The whole plan is available as a spreadsheet.

units.chapters: Ray optics and optical instruments; Wave optics
units.answer: Ray diagrams with arrows; derivations with a labelled figure and the result boxed.
units.prep: The biggest unit: lens and mirror formulae, prism, microscope and telescope, interference and diffraction.

units.chapters: Moving charges and magnetism; Magnetism and matter; Electromagnetic induction; Alternating currents
units.answer: State the law, draw the figure, then derive; give units in every numerical.
units.prep: Biot–Savart and Ampère's law, force between wires, LCR circuits and the transformer.

units.chapters: Electric charges and fields; Potential and capacitance; Current electricity
units.answer: For Gauss's law draw the Gaussian surface; for Kirchhoff's laws mark currents first.
units.prep: Capacitor combinations, the Wheatstone and metre bridges, and the potentiometer.

units.unit: Dual Nature of Radiation and Matter
units.chapters: Photoelectric effect; matter waves
units.answer: Draw the photoelectric graphs with labelled axes.
units.prep: Einstein's equation and de Broglie wavelength numericals.

units.chapters: Semiconductor electronics
units.answer: Circuit diagrams and I–V graphs for diodes and rectifiers.
units.prep: Rectifiers, the Zener diode and logic of the p-n junction.

units.chapters: Atoms; Nuclei
units.answer: Formula-based short answers; balance nuclear equations.
units.prep: Bohr model, binding energy and radioactive decay.

units.chapters: Electromagnetic waves
units.answer: Give the order of the spectrum with one use of each band.
units.prep: Learn the spectrum table.

units.chapters: Haloalkanes and haloarenes; Alcohols, phenols and ethers; Aldehydes, ketones and carboxylic acids; Organic compounds containing nitrogen; Biomolecules
units.answer: Write reactions with reagents and conditions; give mechanisms where asked; name reactions with the equation.
units.prep: Nearly half the paper: make a reactions sheet and practise conversion questions daily.

units.chapters: Solutions; Electrochemistry; Chemical kinetics
units.answer: Show every step of numericals with units; write the formula first.
units.prep: Colligative properties, the Nernst equation and rate-law numericals.

units.chapters: d- and f-block elements; Coordination compounds
units.answer: Give reasons in one line; IUPAC names, hybridisation and magnetic nature in a table.
units.prep: Coordination compounds naming and crystal-field theory, and trends in transition elements.

units.chapters: Continuity & Differentiability; Application of Derivatives; Integrals; Application of Integrals; Differential Equations
units.answer: Show every step, because step marks matter. Draw the region in area questions and write + C.
units.prep: Nearly half the paper: do every NCERT integration exercise, then maxima and minima word problems.

units.chapters: Relations and Functions; Inverse Trigonometric Functions
units.answer: For an equivalence relation, prove reflexive, symmetric and transitive one by one.
units.prep: Learn the table of principal-value branches.

units.chapters: Matrices; Determinants
units.answer: Check an inverse by multiplying back to the identity, and show the cofactors in a grid.
units.prep: Solving equations by the matrix method is almost always asked.

units.chapters: Probability
units.answer: Describe the events in words first. For Bayes' theorem, draw a tree.
units.prep: Bayes' theorem and probability distributions come up often.

units.chapters: Three-dimensional geometry
units.answer: State the formula first; for shortest distance write the vector form.
units.prep: Equations of lines and planes, angle between lines, shortest distance.

units.chapters: Vectors
units.answer: Write vectors with arrows or hats; show dot and cross products step by step.
units.prep: Dot and cross product applications; quick marks.

units.chapters: Linear Programming
units.answer: Draw the graph neatly, shade the feasible region and make a table of corner points.
units.prep: Full marks with one well-practised method.

units.chapters: Sexual Reproduction in Flowering Plants; Human Reproduction; Reproductive Health
units.answer: Labelled diagrams — embryo sac, sections of testis and ovary, the menstrual cycle.
units.prep: Practise the diagrams daily and learn each process as a flowchart.

units.chapters: Principles of Inheritance & Variation; Molecular Basis of Inheritance; Evolution
units.answer: Draw crosses with Punnett squares. Explain the lac operon and DNA replication with diagrams.
units.prep: Second only to Reproduction: start with Molecular Basis of Inheritance and practise crosses.

units.chapters: Organisms & Populations; Ecosystem; Biodiversity & Conservation
units.answer: Use graphs, such as population growth curves, and examples.
units.prep: Short chapters and quick marks.

units.chapters: Human Health & Disease; Microbes in Human Welfare
units.answer: Give disease, pathogen, symptoms and prevention as a table.
units.prep: Revising in tables is fastest.

units.chapters: Biotechnology: Principles & Processes; Biotechnology & its Applications
units.answer: Explain steps in order, such as recombinant DNA and PCR, as a flowchart.
units.prep: Learn the steps of recombinant DNA technology and PCR, and Bt crops.

units.chapters: Composition, directed writing, proposal, grammar; prescribed literature texts
units.answer: Plan compositions before writing and keep to the word limit; quote and explain from the text in literature answers.
units.prep: Write one composition a week and get it checked; revise the literature texts by theme and character.

isc-class-12.papersNote: CISCE publishes specimen question papers, with answer keys for selected subjects, on cisce.org (Examinations → ISC → Specimen Question Papers).
notes: Physics, Chemistry and Biology have a 70-mark theory paper and 30 marks for practical, project work and practical file. Mathematics has an 80-mark theory paper and 20 marks of project work.
ISC Chemistry marks are given for three groups — physical, inorganic and organic — not for each chapter.
For 2027 CISCE says about half of the marks will test higher-order thinking and application. The 2027 Mathematics specimen paper has four sections, all compulsory.

faqs.question: Which Physics unit has the most marks in ISC Class 12?
faqs.answer: Optics, with 18 of the 70 theory marks, followed by Magnetism with Electromagnetic Induction and AC at 16, and Electrostatics with Current Electricity at 14.

faqs.question: How are ISC Class 12 Chemistry marks split?
faqs.answer: Organic chemistry 31, physical chemistry 25 and inorganic chemistry 14, for 70 theory marks.

faqs.question: Which unit matters most in ISC Class 12 Maths?
faqs.answer: Calculus, with 35 of the 80 theory marks. Relations and Functions and Algebra carry 10 each and Probability 9.

faqs.question: How are ISC Class 12 Biology marks split?
faqs.answer: Reproduction 16, Genetics and Evolution 15, Ecology and Environment 15, Biology and Human Welfare 14 and Biotechnology 10.

faqs.question: Where can I get ISC specimen papers for 2027?
faqs.answer: On cisce.org, under the ISC examination section, as Specimen Question Papers.

tips: Start now
Sort the units by marks. Study high-priority units first, then medium, then low.
The top two or three units of most subjects are about half the paper.
Start now
Read the textbook chapter first, then do its exercise questions.
CBSE and UP Board papers follow NCERT books; ICSE and ISC papers follow the CISCE syllabus.
Every week
Sit one full past paper every Sunday in exactly three hours.
It builds speed and shows which units are costing you marks.
Every week
Check your answers against the official marking scheme or answer key, not just the final answer.
It shows the steps and keywords that earn marks.
Last 30 days – weeks 1 and 2
Revise only high and medium units. Make one-page notes of formulas, reactions, diagrams and dates.
These notes are what you will read in the last week.
Last 30 days – week 3
Solve past papers and your board's 2027 sample, model or specimen paper, one a day, timed.
Official papers show the current pattern and level.
Last 30 days – week 4
Re-do every question you got wrong, and revise the low-priority units quickly.
Fixing mistakes gains more marks than reading new topics.
Last 7 days
No new topics. Read your one-page notes and formula sheets, and sleep seven to eight hours.
Memory is fixed during sleep, and tiredness costs marks.
Day before
Light revision only. Pack your admit card, ID, pens, pencil, ruler, eraser and a transparent water bottle.
No exam-day panic.
Reading time
Use it to choose between internal-choice questions and plan the order you will answer in.
You save time and pick the questions you know best.
While writing
Number answers exactly as in the paper, leave a line between answers and underline key words.
Examiners mark many copies quickly; make your marks easy to find.
How much to write
Roughly: 1 mark, one point; 2 marks, two points; 3 marks, three points; 5 marks, five or six points with a diagram or example.
Over-long short answers take time you need for long ones.
Numericals
Formula, values with units, calculation, then the answer boxed with its unit.
Boards give step marks even if the final answer is wrong.
Diagrams
Draw in pencil, label neatly on one side and add a title.
A labelled diagram often carries marks of its own.
Case-based questions
Read the passage or data first; the answer is usually in it.
These questions test reading as much as memory.
MCQs
Attempt every MCQ, ruling out wrong options first.
A blank MCQ always scores zero.
Last 15 minutes
Stop starting new answers. Check question numbers, units and anything you skipped.
It catches small errors that cost easy marks.
